description: Source code for bridge mode management in a network device, including functions to enable/disable bridge mode and manage bridge ports.

methods.name: bridge_mode_none_enable
methods.description: Enables bridge mode by configuring IP interface and logical interface parameters.

methods.name: bridge_mode_none_disable
methods.description: Disables bridge mode by removing IP interface references and disabling the IP interface.

methods.name: bridge_mode_ctrl_action
methods.description: Controls bridge mode enable/disable based on the 'enable' parameter.

methods.name: manage_bridge
methods.description: Adds or disables a bridge port with optional VLAN configuration.
